symbols.name: projection along C
symbols.meaning: The map sending each vector $x$ of $X$ to its component $x_U$ in $U$, for the chosen $U$ and $C$.
symbols.quote: The projection onto $U$ along $C$ is the map $\Theta$ sending $x$ to $x_U$.

symbols.name: complementary subspace
symbols.meaning: A subspace of $X$ that meets $U$ only in zero and whose sum with $U$ is all of $X$.
symbols.quote: Let $U$ be a subspace of $X$, and let $C$ be a subspace of $X$ complementary to $U$, meaning $U \cap C = \{0\}$ and $U + C = X$.

symbols.name: component in U
symbols.meaning: The part of the vector $x$ lying in $U$ in the splitting $x = x_U + x_C$.
symbols.quote: Every vector $x$ of $X$ then splits in exactly one way as $x = x_U + x_C$ with $x_U \in U$ and $x_C \in C$, where $x_U$ is the component of $x$ in $U$ and $x_C$ is its component in $C$.

symbols.name: component in C
symbols.meaning: The part of the vector $x$ lying in $C$ in the splitting $x = x_U + x_C$.
symbols.quote: Every vector $x$ of $X$ then splits in exactly one way as $x = x_U + x_C$ with $x_U \in U$ and $x_C \in C$, where $x_U$ is the component of $x$ in $U$ and $x_C$ is its component in $C$.

symbols.name: projection along orthogonal complement
symbols.meaning: The projection $\Theta$ with $C = U^\perp$, defined when $U$ is nondegenerate.
symbols.quote: Write $\Theta_U$ for the projection onto $U$ along $U^\perp$; the paper calls this map $P_U$.

relations.quote: A projection along a subspace is built from [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md) alone: it uses vector spaces, subspaces and the unique splitting of a vector into two parts.
